brandsCarried: Xiaomi (incl. Loock/Yeelock smart door & cabinet locks, fingerprint padlocks, Mi/Arenti/Linptech video doorbells)
scale: Official Xiaomi store in Uzbekistan; retail shop at Labzak St 78, Tashkent; hours 9:30-19:00
importSignal: Authorized Xiaomi retailer / e-commerce operator importing Xiaomi-ecosystem smart-home devices into Uzbekistan; already sources China-made smart locks and doorbells
fitReason: Hardware retailer already selling China-made smart door locks and access devices online in Tashkent.
angle: Offer OEM/white-label smart locks (fingerprint/password/RFID/Wi-Fi) to broaden their catalog beyond Xiaomi with better margins and localized firmware; propose a distributor/reseller arrangement with China-direct pricing.
risk: Heavily tied to the Xiaomi brand identity; may resist non-Xiaomi lines unless margins and after-sales support are clearly superior.
researchStatus: 已核实为塔什干 Xiaomi 生态电子与智能家居零售商，Labzak 78 有实体店并覆盖全乌兹别克斯坦配送；官网称“Xiaomi 品牌店”，但没有法律主体、INN 或可复核的官方授权证书，也未披露老板、总经理、进口采购或智能锁负责人实名。
